source_text: These rules say that there should be a significant reduction in the number of constituencies in England (from 533 to 501), and require that every constituency – apart from two specified exceptions – must have an electorate that is no smaller than 71,031 and no larger than 78,507.

simplifications.simplification_text: These rules say that there should be a big reduction in the number of constituencies in England (from 533 to 501). They also require that every constituency – apart from two specified exceptions – must have an electorate that is no smaller than 71,031 and no larger than 78,507.
